proposals.before: Hart, courtesy name Lubin, was from Belfast in Ireland.
proposals.after: Hart, courtesy name Lubin, was from Belfast in Britain.
proposals.reason: Chinese states 英國倍爾發司; Ireland is not in the source wording.

proposals.before: In 1889, when Tibetan troops raided Bhutan and British forces intervened, Hart sent his brother Commissioner Hart to Tibet to negotiate the boundary with the resident commissioner.
proposals.after: In 1889, when Tibetan troops raided Sikkim and British forces intervened, Hart sent his brother Commissioner Hart to Tibet to negotiate the boundary with the resident commissioner.
proposals.reason: 哲孟雄 is Sikkim, not Bhutan.

proposals.before: In the fifteenth year Tibetan troops raided Bhutan; British troops took advantage to intrude; Hart sent his younger brother, Customs Commissioner Hart junior, posthaste to confer with the resident commissioner in Tibet on boundary matters.
proposals.after: In the fifteenth year Tibetan troops raided Sikkim; British troops took advantage to intrude; Hart sent his younger brother, Customs Commissioner Hart junior, posthaste to confer with the resident commissioner in Tibet on boundary matters.
proposals.reason: 哲孟雄 is Sikkim, not Bhutan.

proposals.before: After the 1911 revolution he died in office and received generous posthumous honors.
proposals.after: After the 1911 revolution he died of illness and received generous posthumous honors.
proposals.reason: Chinese is 病卒; he had already resigned earlier, so “in office” invents a false circumstance.

proposals.before: He concluded joint postal regulations with France, Germany, and British India.
proposals.after: He concluded joint postal regulations with France, Germany, and British Natal.
proposals.reason: 英屬那達 refers to Natal, not British India; the literal already preserves Nada/Natal.

decisions.reason: s0131 reads 英國倍爾發司人; the source places Belfast in Britain (英國) and never names Ireland. Replacing Ireland with Britain restores the Chinese polity label without other change.
s0147 has 藏兵寇哲孟雄; 哲孟雄 is Sikkim, not Bhutan (不丹). The proposed idiomatic corrects that place-name error and otherwise preserves the sentence.
The same 哲孟雄 in s0147 must be Sikkim in the literal; Bhutan invents the wrong polity. The proposed replacement fixes only that toponym.
s0159 is 辛亥後，病卒，賜優恤; 病卒 means he died of illness. “Died in office” invents a circumstance absent from the Chinese; the proposed wording restores 病卒 accurately.
s0174 names 英屬那達, distinct from 英屬印度 in s0172; 那達 is Natal. British India misreads that toponym, and British Natal matches the Chinese.
